bio: A meal in this warehouse, revamped in a casual, trendy vibe, should be on the bucket list of any self-respecting foodie. We warrant that the intriguing beverage lineup and lunchtime choice of a 2-, 3- or 4-course menus, together with the 5-course evening menu, will tickle your curiosity and tantalise your tastebuds. How about a subtle mix of wafer-thin slices and mousse of smoked salmon enhanced by a delicate sweet caramel coulis of pinenuts and cherries with chunky bits? Fascinating food that savvily melds sweet fruity notes with smoky aromas. Should you be a fan of sourdough bread, you will be delighted to know that you can buy some to take home....
